releaseNotes: Restaurant Mode: qualify leads by the delivery platform behind their Order Now flow (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Postmates, Grubhub/Seamless, Toast, ChowNow, Slice), with include/exclude platform selection and skip-or-tag handling. Scrape multiple business categories in one run. Notes now capture the delivery platform and the site builder credit (footer 'Powered by …'). Paused scrapes get a Stop & Save button alongside Resume.
